subject: Eval acceptance criteria / DPA & SOC 2 timing for Proof-of-Value
messages:
From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@finserv.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <carlos.jimenez@finserv.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof-of-Value: compliance checklist + timeline

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Procurement + Security want to capture the compliance gates we need to clear to move the PoV to a contractual pilot. Can you confirm the following so we can build a mutual action plan with dates?

Quick asks:
- Do you have a current SOC 2 report (Type II) we can review, or a timeline to produce one?
- Can you provide a completed SIG/CAIQ (or equivalent) for our security team?
- Do you have a standard DPA we can start with (and any required redline constraints around data retention)?
- Proposed retention default for customer logs & request traces (we currently prefer 24 months but can be flexible).

Target timeline from our side: decision on pilot commitment by EOW Oct 8, legal signoff by Oct 22 if compliance checks pass.

Would you and legal be able to share artifacts this week so we can slot a technical review with Carlos?

Best,
Megan
Megan Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager | FinServ Co.
Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@finserv.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof-of-Value: compliance checklist + timeline

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear list. Putting answers below and attaching a one-page MAP overview so we have a shared timeline. I copied our legal and AE to keep things moving.

Summary answers (short):
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II for our serving platform; the latest report (summary) attached. We can provide an SOC 2 bridging letter and a redacted report under NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: Attached is our completed matrix (spreadsheet) with controls mapped; security may want a short walkthrough with Carlos.
- DPA: Draft DPA attached. Key retention default: 13 months for request logs by default; we can extend to 24 months for regulated customers with an addendum.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) 2026-10-01: Share artifacts (SOC 2 summary, SIG/CAIQ, DPA draft) — attached.
2) 2026-10-04: Security technical review (Carlos + Redwood SE) — schedule if that works.
3) 2026-10-08: Internal FinServ decision on pilot commitment.
4) 2026-10-15: Legal redlines complete and DPA signoff / DocuSign initiated.

Open items / asks for you:
- Can Carlos confirm available windows for 10/4 or 10/5 for a 60-min walkthrough?
- If procurement needs a 24-month retention default in the DPA, is that a hard requirement or negotiable? We proposed 13 months by default to reduce exposure but can scope a longer retention period for pilot datasets.

Attachments: MAP-vFinServ-2026-10-04.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ_Response_FIN-SVC.xlsx, Draft_DPA_Redwood_vFinServ.docx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Carlos Jimenez <carlos.jimenez@finserv.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Megan Torres <megan.torres@finserv.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof-of-Value: compliance checklist + timeline

Vivek / Tessa — quick technical follow-up after a first pass on the SIG spreadsheet. A few notes:

- We have questions on network segmentation and key rotation cadence (SIG control 3.2/3.3). Can you provide the current KMS model and rotation schedule?
- On data retention: request logs vs. content data need clear separation. Our security posture requires policy for content retention (customer data) to be explicitly set per-customer. 24 months default for logs is fine, but content retention should be configurable and limited to the minimum needed (we expect <12 months for content by default).
- SOC 2: Can you confirm the reporting period for the attached summary and whether the report covers the hosting/serving layers used in the PoV (GPU clusters, caching layers)?

We can target the walkthrough on Mon 2026-10-04 11:00 PT. If that works, please send an invite.

—Carlos
Carlos Jimenez
Security Engineer | FinServ Co.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proof-of-Value: compliance checklist + timeline — DPA retention ask

Laura — forwarding Megan/Carlos' notes. Procurement is pushing for 24 months default retention for request logs and wants content retention to be configurable but prefers <12 months by default. We currently propose 13 months default for logs and configurable content retention.

Can you review the attached DPA draft and confirm whether:
- We can accept a contract clause that sets 24 months for request logs for this pilot (and add a note that commercial customers may request longer retention via addendum).
- We should push to explicitly state redaction/aggregation responsibilities and incident notification SLAs in the DPA.

If any of this needs leadership escalation, say so — otherwise, can we get a redline back by COB Mon 10/4?

Thanks — Vivek

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof-of-Value: compliance checklist + timeline — DPA redline & artifacts

Hi Megan / Carlos — thanks for the walkthrough earlier today. Per our call and internal review, please find the items we are sharing now:

1) Updated Draft DPA (attached) — we accepted pilot-specific language to set request-log retention to 24 months for the PoV. The contract includes an explicit addendum path for extended retention if needed after pilot.
2) SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet — we filled in clarifications on KMS rotation cadence and provided a pointer to our KMS runbook (internal link below).
3) SOC 2 summary — reporting period: 2025-06 through 2026-05; coverage includes our serving/runtime platform (GPU clusters, KV cache layer, network isolation). Full redacted report available upon NDA.

Next steps / asks for FinServ:
- Confirm acceptance of the PoV DPA redline by COB 10/08 so we can proceed with the pilot commit.
- If you need the full SOC 2 report, please return the signed mutual NDA (we attached a short one).

Artifacts attached: Draft_DPA_Redwood_vFinServ.docx, SIG-CAIQ_Response_FIN-SVC.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf

Links:
- MAP & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-vFinServ-2026-10-04
- KMS runbook (internal): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation

If anything requires leadership escalation, ping me and Vivek and we will route it.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
